assembled_text: Photorealistic cinematic historical documentary. Natural physical proportions. Historically plausible reconstruction. Realistic materials. Natural lighting. No fantasy. No modern objects. No text. No logos. No excessive saturation. No glossy AI look. No malformed anatomy. No arbitrary architecture changes. Early Silla, Gyeongju royal capital, 5th to early 6th century. Elite burial construction context. Modest timber work spaces, no palace spectacle. Forbidden: Joseon dynasty hanbok; gat hats; Ming or Qing court robes; samurai armor; European medieval armor; fantasy armor; giant stone palace; Joseon-style tiled palace compound; Chinese imperial palace; pagoda skyline; torii gates; stone mausoleum / pyramid / Chinese-style tomb gateway; modern tools, excavators, cranes, wheeled modern carts; concrete, electric lights, plastic, modern roads; supernatural ghosts, glowing magic, fantasy crown; modern museum display cases. DDABONG Sageuk Cinematic Reenactment (style B2, D-051): photoreal Korean period-drama film look. Faces cast like contemporary Korean drama actors - attractive, natural, distinct from one another, never a portrait of a real person; real skin texture with visible pores, fine lines and sun marks, no gloss, no wax, no plastic. Clothing, hair, ornaments and tools strictly historically researched (early Silla), never Joseon hanbok, never fantasy. Lighting: low golden key light from a 45-degree side, soft atmospheric haze, thin warm rim light on hair and shoulders, shallow depth of field, fine film grain; night scenes lit by amber torch or lamp light against cool blue shadow. Colour: deep saturated fabrics, earth and metal, natural sky and skin, not over-saturated, not anime, not illustration. Figures still and composed; wide and medium framing preferred, faces often in profile, silhouette or backlight. RANK LINEUP SAMPLE for owner review: three Silla men standing side by side on plain packed earth in soft late-afternoon light, full length, same scale, facing camera three-quarter, evenly spaced, clearly separated. LEFT: the senior elite observer exactly as in the attached reference image (same face, grey-blue silk long-sleeved robe, silver-plaque leather belt with three short pendants, low blunt silk-covered birch-bark cap, ankle boots). MIDDLE: a funeral attendant in his late 30s. COSTUME_SILLA_ATTENDANT_A01 V02 DRAFT (evidence-corrected, CLM_SILLA_COSTUME_021-031): Silla funeral attendant, 5th to early 6th century. ONE evenly woven, better-bleached plain-weave jacket, hip length or slightly longer, LONG sleeves to the wrist with clean plain cuffs, straight collar crossed shallowly (right over left or left over right), no ribbon ties; medium-width plain trousers; a neat plain cloth belt, no metal plaques, no pendants; low shoes; hair in a neat topknot, bare or with a plain cloth band; off-white, light grey or grey-brown tones, clean and tidy. MORE items than a labourer, far fewer than the elite observer: no silk, no cap of rank, no metal belt, no ankle boots. Forbidden: short sleeves, futou hat, round-collar danryeong, bronze or iron belt buckle, metal plaques, Joseon hanbok silhouette, ribbon ties, official colours. RIGHT: a labourer in his early 30s. COSTUME_SILLA_LABORER_A01 V02 DRAFT (evidence-corrected, CLM_SILLA_COSTUME_021-031): Silla labourer, 5th to early 6th century. ONE coarse, unbleached, loosely woven plain-weave jacket, hip length, LONG narrow sleeves to the wrist, straight collar crossed shallowly (right over left or left over right), no ribbon ties; narrow plain trousers; a simple twisted cloth waist cord, no metal; straw sandals; hair in a topknot, bare or with a plain cloth band; natural off-white, grey-brown or dark undyed tones, dusty and worn. FEWEST items of all ranks: no cap, no belt ornament, no bag. Forbidden: short sleeves, bare chest as default, ankle-bound trousers, futou hat, bronze or iron belt buckle, Joseon hanbok silhouette, ribbon ties, gat hat, bright dye, official colours. The difference in rank must read from the NUMBER of items worn (elder = full set, attendant = limited, labourer = minimal), not from bright colours. Three distinct ordinary faces, not glamorous. No text, no labels, no watermark, no logo.
